capsules.intent: Keep every authenticated StarCi dashboard and operational console inside one exact profile-owned visual theme across chrome, navigation, content and responsive forms.
decisionQuestions: Is the addressed surface an authenticated dashboard or operational console?
Does every viewport and navigation state preserve the same routed StarCi visual identity?

interactionProof.assertion: Ground, surface, foreground, muted, accent, separator, typography, radius and elevation resolve to the exact grammar-locked token values.
The selected navigation destination uses the soft surface derived from the exact accent owned by the routed profile.
Expanded rail, collapsed rail, mobile chrome and drawer keep the same locked theme contract.

capsules.intent: Render comparable peer rows as one bounded collection with shared edge-to-edge separators.
decisionQuestions: Are the members comparable peers rather than parent and descendant groups?
Does one boundary own the separators between every row?

interactionProof.assertion: Exactly one bounded surface contains the complete peer collection.
Every interior divider reaches both shared surface edges.

capsules.intent: Keep parent groups, descendants, local disclosure, search and progress summaries under one hierarchy owner.
decisionQuestions: Do members contain ordered descendants rather than compare as peers?
May each parent reveal its descendants independently?

interactionProof.assertion: The parent containing the active descendant remains expanded.
A descendant match retains its parent and reveals the matching row.

capsules.intent: Delegate single-selection destination traversal, activation and focus behavior to one ListBox owner.
decisionQuestions: Are these rows destinations rather than informational peers?
Must keyboard traversal and one current destination be preserved?

interactionProof.assertion: Arrow traversal and activation remain owned by the ListBox primitive.
At most one destination exposes selected state at a time.

capsules.intent: Keep viewable gates operable and render prominent locked, rank or due facts as semantic trailing chips.
decisionQuestions: Does activation lead to an explanatory gate rather than a forbidden destination?
Does the trailing fact carry actionable semantic emphasis?

interactionProof.assertion: A viewable gated destination is not exposed as disabled.
A zero due count produces no trailing attention chip.

capsules.intent: Resize one persistent content rail along a shared zero-width separator while rail and body keep independent scroll planes.
decisionQuestions: Must the reader continuously choose the rail width rather than switch between two presentations?
Do the rail and routed body own separate scrolling?

interactionProof.assertion: Pointer drag and keyboard arrows change only the bounded inline width.
Rail right, separator left and body left share one coordinate while separator layout width is zero.
Scrolling the body does not change the rail scroll position and the inverse also holds.

capsules.intent: Keep boundary geometry, collapsible navigation inset, resizable panel inset and primary inset as separate owners.
decisionQuestions: Which plane owns each inset rather than borrowing spacing from its neighbor?
Does the sticky boundary start at the navbar edge without counting internal padding twice?

interactionProof.assertion: Collapsible navigation keeps 24px block and 12px inline padding; resizable content keeps 12px inline and zero outer block padding.
A fixed learn route has zero document scroll range after navbar and separator accounting.

capsules.intent: Port the StarCi collapsible navigation owner exactly: one bordered motion host, one circular ghost SidebarSimple toggle, an optional evidenced title and state-specific inset around the same destination order.
decisionQuestions: Are there exactly two meaningful navigation presentations rather than a continuously chosen width?
Can compact destinations retain meaning through stable glyphs and accessible labels?

interactionProof.assertion: A visible keyboard-operable control toggles the two rail presentations and exposes the current collapsed state.
The header keeps one circular ghost SidebarSimple toggle; it renders a title only when the routed product supplies evidenced title copy, and compact state hides that title without swapping glyphs.
The motion host keeps one full-height separator on its trailing edge in both width states.
Expanded rail resolves to 24px on every edge; compact rail resolves to 24px block and 12px inline inset.
Collapse and expand preserve the same motion host identity.
Reduced-motion preference changes width immediately without interpolation.
The adjacent body reflows beside the changed rail width.

capsules.intent: Render compact navigation as an accessible hit target containing one independently painted circular glyph surface.
decisionQuestions: Does the compact form intentionally remove visible copy while preserving destination meaning?
Is the painted circle smaller than the accessible hit target?

interactionProof.assertion: The accessible target remains larger than the painted circular surface.
Hover and selection paint only the inner circle.

capsules.intent: Keep rail controls pinned while only long repeating destination groups own bounded internal scrolling.
decisionQuestions: Which repeating content may move without carrying controls and overview with it?
Would a native scrollbar thumb compete visually with the rail separator?

interactionProof.assertion: Scrolling destination groups leaves collapse, overview and progress controls fixed.
The internal viewport scrolls while its native scrollbar thumb remains hidden.

capsules.intent: Give live evaluated work the viewport and restore persistent chrome only after the result state begins.
decisionQuestions: Is this an active evaluated work session rather than its setup or result page?
Does the surface already own the controls needed while work is live?

interactionProof.assertion: Persistent navigation and assistant are absent during the live evaluated phase.
The result phase restores the persistent application chrome.

capsules.intent: Replace an unreachable wide destination column with one bottom navigation form that switches one local panel.
decisionQuestions: Are the narrow controls peer destinations rather than primary actions?
Does switching them change a local panel without changing route identity?

interactionProof.assertion: Exactly one available local destination panel is visible.
Removing backing content also removes its destination and resets stale selection.

capsules.intent: Preserve orientation on shallow paths and replace paths of depth three or more with one legal return affordance.
decisionQuestions: Does the path contain at least three ordered steps?
Which nearest ancestor exposes a legal navigation action?

interactionProof.assertion: Exactly one breadcrumb trail or one Back link is rendered for the addressed path.
The Back link activates the deepest pressable ancestor and never the current step.

capsules.intent: Keep bounded independent tab axes operable without label wrapping as the available inline measure changes.
decisionQuestions: Do the tab axes change independent dimensions with separate selected keys?
Which axes still have more than one enabled choice?

interactionProof.assertion: Changing one selected tab key does not mutate the companion axis selection.
A narrow variable-width tab axis contains its own horizontal overflow without wrapping labels.

capsules.intent: Render an authored multi-block document without flattening semantics or leaking wide content into the page.
decisionQuestions: Does the payload carry meaningful block structure rather than inline-only copy?
Which optional outline, selection and extension capabilities are explicitly requested?

interactionProof.assertion: Headings, lists, quotes, code and tables retain their semantic elements after rendering.
Wide code and table blocks scroll locally while the reading column remains min-width zero.
The document outline and rendered headings use the same stable parsed heading identities.
Passage selection grounding exists only inside an explicitly selectable document boundary.

capsules.intent: Give exactly one persisted next or resume destination the highlighted continuation surface while every secondary destination remains ordinary.
decisionQuestions: Is exactly one destination the learner's persisted next decision?
Would highlighting more than one destination destroy the primary continuation hierarchy?

interactionProof.assertion: Exactly one continuation surface carries highlighted emphasis in the addressed section.
The highlighted surface exposes one keyboard-operable action that opens the persisted continuation target.

capsules.intent: Extend one closed icon vocabulary only for stable product meanings that have no faithful upstream glyph.
decisionQuestions: Is the meaning stable product vocabulary rather than a brand mark or reaction?
Has the approved upstream vocabulary been checked for a faithful glyph?

interactionProof.assertion: Both required optical cuts export under one closed product meaning.
Every extension glyph inherits currentColor instead of owning paint.
